description: Grain (2/2) — Classification Value nội bộ Datamart (không tồn tại trên Atomic), 4 giá trị cố định: STOCK/BOND/FUND_CERT/TOTAL
etl_logic:
'STOCK' -- STOCK
UNION ALL 'BOND' -- BOND
UNION ALL 'FUND_CERT' -- FUND_CERT
UNION ALL 'TOTAL' -- TOTAL

description: SUM Execution Value phía mua theo từng Security Type Group (xem điều kiện filter riêng từng branch trong Ghi chú thiết kế HLD Nhóm 14)
etl_logic:
SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) WHERE (securities_trade.market_id_code = 'STO' AND securities_trade.buy_foreign_investor_tp_code <> '00') OR (securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('STX','UPX') AND securities_trade.buy_foreign_investor_tp_code IN ('10','20')) -- STOCK
UNION ALL SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) WHERE (securities_trade.market_id_code = 'BDO' AND securities_trade.buy_foreign_investor_tp_code <> '00') OR (securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('BDX','HCX') AND securities_trade.buy_foreign_investor_tp_code IN ('10','20')) -- BOND
UNION ALL SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) WHERE securities_trade.market_id_code = 'STO' AND securities_trade.buy_investor_tp_code = '7000' AND securities_dim.stock_tp_code = '3' -- FUND_CERT (join Securities Dimension chỉ để filter, không lưu FK)
UNION ALL SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) WHERE securities_trade.buy_foreign_investor_tp_code <> '00' -- TOTAL (không filter Market_Id_Code)
source_attribute: Execution Value / Market Id Code / Buy Foreign Investor Type Code / Buy Investor Type Code

description: SUM Execution Value phía bán theo từng Security Type Group (cùng pattern filter với Buy Value, đổi buy_*→sell_*)
etl_logic:
SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) WHERE (securities_trade.market_id_code = 'STO' AND securities_trade.sell_foreign_investor_tp_code <> '00') OR (securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('STX','UPX') AND securities_trade.sell_foreign_investor_tp_code IN ('10','20')) -- STOCK
UNION ALL SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) WHERE (securities_trade.market_id_code = 'BDO' AND securities_trade.sell_foreign_investor_tp_code <> '00') OR (securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('BDX','HCX') AND securities_trade.sell_foreign_investor_tp_code IN ('10','20')) -- BOND
UNION ALL SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) WHERE securities_trade.market_id_code = 'STO' AND securities_trade.sell_investor_tp_code = '7000' AND securities_dim.stock_tp_code = '3' -- FUND_CERT
UNION ALL SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) WHERE securities_trade.sell_foreign_investor_tp_code <> '00' -- TOTAL
source_attribute: Execution Value / Market Id Code / Sell Foreign Investor Type Code / Sell Investor Type Code
